risk_note: RV2 (agent budget / model-gateway routing / stream admission and finalize, packages/money, content config registry, migration 0158). B3-09o takes over B3-09m (void; orchestrator D10-3188 / D10-3189): platform-wide daily AI model budget and usage booking per BR-AI-16 as rewritten 2026-11-25 (owner option 甲, SPEC_REF 1025764be5af). Admission transaction: committed (actual + reserved) of the Asia/Shanghai day >= the smallest budget of all apps -> the run degrades without a model (finish_reason budget), else reserves R = agent.budget.reserve_mfen_per_run (largest of all apps, default 5,000 mfen), which is also the run's spend cap; before each model call the worst cost W (request bytes x in price + max_tokens x out price) must fit R - U and max_tokens is set from what is left; the terminal transaction settles the reservation once (settled_at IS NULL), booking the live spend U, or R in full when another process settles; everything is booked on the admission day; alerts at 80% / 100% are best effort. Unit prices are a snapshot of the run's own app's agent.models taken at admission, each call priced by its model's entry; price_version = the first priced route candidate at admission (D10-3193). Orchestrator rulings carried by this change: D10-3187 (seven findings of the B3-09m money review: request never handed to fetch is not charged; reserve read failure takes the default with a warning while a budget read failure fails closed; candidates are not filtered by price version; a budget stop after delivered content goes on to the no-model path; the run's model clock follows agent.model_timeout_ms; config changes take effect from the next read, FU-AGENT-BUDGET-CONFIG-EFFECTIVE-TIME; the admin trace read side is out of scope, FU-ADMIN-TRACE-PRICE-VERSION), D10-3193, D10-3207 (duplicate product cards after a budget degrade: FU-AGENT-BUDGET-DEGRADE-DUP-CARDS), D10-3329 / D10-3330 (late vendor usage rebooks a W charge once, as reported; max_tokens at a digit boundary and a template run under budget are accepted as known behaviour: FU-AGENT-BUDGET-MAXTOKENS-DIGIT-BOUNDARY, FU-AGENT-BUDGET-TEMPLATE-RUN-DEGRADE). Production is unchanged by the merge: the budgeted model path is built only with the test seam seams.modelRouting; the production route stays no_model until B3-03k wires the gateway.
